subject: Need extra lead time for demo — prompt evaluation, sample data & travel alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>, Daniel Park <dpark@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Need extra lead time for demo — prompt evaluation, sample data & travel alignment

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Quick note ahead of next week’s Finlytics demo (scheduled 2026-10-08): we’re asking for a short postponement so we can finish two critical prep items that materially affect demo fidelity:

- Finalize prompt sets and a small eval sweep against your workload traces (we found a couple of prompt edge cases yesterday)
- Complete sample data ingest + SSO/service account access so demo runs on production-like inputs
- Allow Marcus (engineer running the load tests) to be on site — he’s traveling and needs one extra business day to arrive/setup

Options that would give us the runway we need: +48–72 hours (i.e., move the demo to 2026-10-10/11). We can do a short executive-friendly walkthrough on the original date if you need a placeholder, but we strongly recommend the extra lead time to avoid showing an early, noisy run.

I’ve attached the minimal sample dataset and the runbook for your ops team to review. If shifting is impossible on your side, tell us and we’ll keep the original slot and scope the demo down to the integration overview only.

Proposed next steps:
1) Tell us whether 10/10 or 10/11 works for the Finlytics team
2) Ops, please confirm whether the attached access_matrix.xlsx gets you what you need for SSO/service account config

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachment: sample_dataset.csv (CSV, 2.3MB)
Attachment: runbook.pdf (PDF, 520KB)
Attachment: access_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finlytics.com>

Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@finlytics.com>, Finlytics Ops <ops@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need extra lead time for demo — prompt evaluation, sample data & travel alignment

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the heads up.

We definitely want the demo to reflect live-like inputs. 10/10 and 10/11 are both options for us from a calendar perspective but I need ops to confirm SSO windows. Looping in our Ops alias — @ops, can you take a look at the access_matrix and confirm whether a 72-hour window is sufficient to provision the service account and test SSO?

If ops can’t make 10/10–10/11, can we propose a fallback week of 10/17–10/18? Also, small ask: can your team run the prompt sweep against the workload traces and share a short summary of any differences you see versus our expectations (1–2 bullets)? That will help our PM be prepared for the demo Q&A.

— Priya
Priya Shah 
Head of Integrations, Finlytics
priya.shah@finlytics.com

Subject: Re: Need extra lead time for demo — prompt evaluation, sample data & travel alignment

Thanks Priya —

Summary of what we’ll deliver before a proposed 10/10 run:
- Prompt evaluation: quick 300-example sweep across your traces; we’ll flag 3–5 prompts that need small wording tweaks and one template that returns degenerate output under short context. Expect a 1-page summary (PDF) by EOD 10/05.
- Sample data: ingest pipeline completed in staging; we still need the service account and SSO confirmation from ops to run the final dry run.
- Runbook: attached, includes step-by-step for swapping to the canary model variant if we hit latency SLO regressions during the demo.

Proposed demo windows (all PDT):
- Option A: Mon 10/10, 11:00–11:45 (exec-friendly, shorter)
- Option B: Tue 10/11, 09:30–10:30 (longer, includes latency/load check)
- Fallback: Thu 10/15, 14:00–15:00 (if travel or ops forces a later date)

If Finlytics wants to keep 10/08 as a placeholder, we can do a 20-minute high-level overview but we won’t run the full sample workload. Given Marcus is traveling, Option B gives him time to land and run the canary test with the sample dataset.

I’ll reattach the three files for ops and add the short eval summary when ready.

— Soojin

Subject: Re: Need extra lead time for demo — prompt evaluation, sample data & travel alignment

+1 to Option B (Tue 10/11, 09:30). I’ll be onsite and need the extra day to finish local GPU setup and the canary throughput run. Also request we add a 10-minute canary at the top of the demo to validate tokenization/formatting after the ingest — that will prevent a long outage if something looks off.

Soojin / Hannah: I’ll post the canary checklist to the shared folder by EOD today.

We’ll still keep 10/08 as a 20-minute placeholder for stakeholders who want a quick overview, but we prefer the full run on 10/11. I also saw the attached runbook and dataset — looks good from our side.

See you next week.
